newsitem.title: GERMANY: Seven die in German house fire.
newsitem.headline: Seven die in German house fire.

text.p: Seven people, including two children, died in a fire in the southwest German town of Sulzbach overnight, probably caused by an exploding oil stove, police said on Thursday.
Another six residents of the three-storey house managed to escape the flames, including one man who climbed out of a window with his nine month-old son.
Around 100 firemen were called out to tackle the blaze, which completely destroyed the building.
